_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

columns.name: active_branch_id
columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES entry_branches (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES entry_branches (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entry_branches" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "library_entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES library_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active_branch_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES entry_branches (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "cover_url" TEXT NULL, "media_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "excluded_scanlators" TEXT NULL, "source_key" TEXT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "last_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "reader_mode" INTEGER NULL, "reader_dual_page_mode" INTEGER NULL, "custom_cover_path" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("profile_id", "source_id", "external_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_units" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "library_entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES library_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "number" REAL NOT NULL, "display_title" TEXT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "downloaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("downloaded" IN (0, 1)), "scanlator" TEXT NULL, "bookmarked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("bookmarked" IN (0, 1)), "local_path" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("library_entry_id", "url"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chapter_progress" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "content_unit_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES content_units (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "branch_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES entry_branches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "consumed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("consumed" IN (0, 1)), "consumed_at" INTEGER NULL, "progress_position" REAL NULL, UNIQUE ("content_unit_id", "branch_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "exclude_from_update" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_from_update" IN (0, 1)), "media_type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "use_smart_rule" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("use_smart_rule" IN (0, 1)), "sort_field" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_ascending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("sort_ascending" IN (0, 1)), "status_filter" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entry_categories" ("library_entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES library_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("library_entry_id", "category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "log_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "stack_trace" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installed_sources" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "lang" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en', "media_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "js_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "base_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "engine_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'js', "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "repo_url" TEXT NULL, "repo_source_id" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "repos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "url" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "active_profile" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "setting_values" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "setting_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("synced" IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE ("profile_id", "setting_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "library_entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES library_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "content_unit_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES content_units (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "branch_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES entry_branches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "read_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_deletions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("profile_id", "entity", "client_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "applying" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "install_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_profile_state" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "server_profile_id" INTEGER NULL, "server_profile_name" TEXT NULL, "since" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "local_since" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "auto_sync_interval_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_on_launch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("sync_on_launch" IN (0, 1)), "background_sync" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("background_sync" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_files" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "kind", "name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracker_links" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "library_entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES library_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tracker" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'anilist', "remote_media_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remote_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_chapters" INTEGER NULL, "linked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("library_entry_id", "tracker"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracker_outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "link_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tracker_links (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "first_queued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "next_try_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE ("link_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_library_entries_source ON library_entries (source_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_library_entries_client_id ON library_entries (client_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_library_entries_updated_at ON library_entries (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_branches_entry ON entry_branches (library_entry_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_entry_branches_client_id ON entry_branches (client_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_branches_updated_at ON entry_branches (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_content_units_entry ON content_units (library_entry_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_content_units_updates ON content_units (date_uploaded)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_content_units_client_id ON content_units (client_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_content_units_updated_at ON content_units (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_chapter_progress_branch ON chapter_progress (branch_id, consumed, consumed_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_chapter_progress_client_id ON chapter_progress (client_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_chapter_progress_updated_at ON chapter_progress (updated_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_categories_client_id ON categories (client_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_categories_updated_at ON categories (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_categories_category ON entry_categories (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_log_entries_time ON log_entries (timestamp)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_installed_sources_client_id ON installed_sources (client_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_installed_sources_updated_at ON installed_sources (updated_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_repos_client_id ON repos (client_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_repos_updated_at ON repos (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_setting_values_setting ON setting_values (setting_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_reading_sessions_entry_time ON reading_sessions (library_entry_id, read_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_reading_sessions_time ON reading_sessions (read_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_reading_sessions_client_id ON reading_sessions (client_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_reading_sessions_updated_at ON reading_sessions (updated_at)
